correctness.rationale: PASS. Rotate any three-cycle to its unique smallest vertex p<=349. Every outgoing q is a prime divisor of F(p)=p^2-p+1 and every subsequent r a prime divisor of F(q), so two-stage complete factorization exhausts the infinite condition without upper bounds on q,r. Independent SymPy enumeration recovered exactly 70 candidate p->q->r paths and exactly one closing cycle (349,121453,9710803); primality/divisibilities and H(pqr)=F(p)F(q)F(r)/(pqr)=410433300314317 verified exactly. No stronger claim for p>349.
